title: Text-Based Personas for Simulating User Privacy Decisions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating population-level alignment by measuring the Total Variation Distance (TVD) and TVComplement between the aggregate statistical distribution of synthetic persona privacy responses and the real-world survey response distributions.

Assessing the predictive accuracy of synthetic personas generated using a 'Bounded Rationality' framework, which explicitly prompts the model to incorporate human cognitive biases (e.g., optimism bias, present bias) and heuristics to simulate privacy decision-making.
